content.short: 0xCert is a JavaScript framework for building decentralized applications and managing ERC standards, including ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-2477.
content.description: 0xCert is a JavaScript framework that provides developers with a comprehensive toolkit for building a wide range of blockchain applications. Its composable architecture supports multiple ERC token standards—fungible tokens like ERC-20 and non-fungible tokens such as ERC-721 and ERC-2477—while storing assets and data on immutable, distributed systems. This approach enables robust, interoperable smart contract development across diverse networks and use cases.
